channel.title: UK Defence Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: Defence wiring firm Westwire expands with new Swindon site
item.description: Westwire Harnessing has opened a second UK manufacturing facility in Swindon, expanding production capacity and creating around 80 new jobs. The post Defence wiring firm Westwire expands with new Swindon site first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Spain puts all of its Aegis frigates to sea at once
item.description: The Spanish Navy has deployed all five of its F-100 Alvaro de Bazan-class frigates simultaneously in what it described as a rare operational and logistical milestone for the Armada. The post Spain puts all of its Aegis frigates to sea at once first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK to gift Mogadishu operating base to African Union
item.description: The UK is set to gift a compound at Mogadishu International Airport, previously known as Operating Base SHAND, to the African Union support and stabilisation mission in Somalia (AUSSOM). The post UK to gift Mogadishu operating base to African Union first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: U.S. Army receives first LRIP 2 Sentinel A4 radar system
item.description: Lockheed Martin has delivered the first Sentinel A4 radar from Low-Rate Initial Production (LRIP) 2 batch to the U.S. Army, as the company moves the system closer toward full-rate production. The post U.S. Army receives first LRIP 2 Sentinel A4 radar system first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK Digital Targeting Web ‘minimum product’ due this year
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has said it aims to deliver the first elements of its Digital Targeting Web programme this year, describing the capability as an evolving ecosystem rather than a single platform. The post UK Digital Targeting Web ‘minimum product’ due this year first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Trident missile fire control contract awarded
item.description: The U.S. Navy has awarded General Dynamics Mission Systems a contract covering work on the Strategic Weapon System Fire Control Subsystem, with the deal also supporting the UK ballistic missile submarine force. The post Trident missile fire control contract awarded first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Babcock teams with ASELSAN on RAF air defence training
item.description: Babcock has signed a memorandum of understanding with Turkish firm ASELSAN to explore a potential training system for the Royal Air Force under the Next Generation Operational Training (NGOT) programme. The post Babcock teams with ASELSAN on RAF air defence training first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Archer artillery support contract to be awarded to BAE
item.description: The Ministry of Defence intends to award BAE Systems Bofors AB a short-term in-service support contract for the British Army Archer artillery system. The post Archer artillery support contract to be awarded to BAE first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Taiwan to receive Legion-ES IRST under Lockheed deal
item.description: Lockheed Martin has been awarded a contract by the U.S. government to produce IRST21 Legion-ES infrared search-and-track sensor systems for the Taiwanese Air Force. The post Taiwan to receive Legion-ES IRST under Lockheed deal first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: US Marine Corps orders more BAE-built Amphibious Vehicles
item.description: The ACV-30 is equipped with a 30mm cannon and is intended to provide increased firepower for engaging targets at range. The post US Marine Corps orders more BAE-built Amphibious Vehicles first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
